column3: Just wait until you see what I have to trade, kupo. All sorts of trinkets and baubles I'm positive you adventurer types will like... If only I could remember where I put it all.
The Mogpendium will prove to be an invaluable resource during the Moogle Treasure Trove, kupo!
Pore over its contents to find the best ways to get your hands on irregular tomestones, then use that knowledge to fill your packs!
And once the weight of your tomestones becomes too much to bear, bring them to me and I'll give you all sorts of rare and remarkable items!

Oh, and it seems there were some minor errors in the Mogpendium. I've gone ahead and marked minimog challenges from week six of the first hunt for astronomy as complete for you. Just don't tell my boss, kupo!
The completion period for certain duties in the Mogpendium was listed incorrectly and differed from the event end date.
As compensation to those who were unable to attempt these duties within the allotted time, the itinerant moogle is providing a helping paw to complete these goals.
